samples.title: Giờ làm linh hoạt
samples.prompt: Your friend invited you to a flexible working discussion, but you cannot attend. Write to apologise, explain your reason, and suggest another way to meet or learn about the topic.

samples.summaryVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Từ chối
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thank you very much for inviting me to a flexible working discussion. It sounds interesting, especially because employees can organise work around practical personal needs. Unfortunately, I will not be able to join you on Saturday at nine in the morning.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lời cảm ơn rồi báo không tham gia được.

paragraphs.label: Lý do
paragraphs.text: I have to attend a family appointment that was arranged earlier. This was arranged earlier, and I cannot change it now. I realise that you may already have made plans, so I wanted to tell you as soon as possible rather than leave you waiting for an answer.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lý do cụ thể và tôn trọng sắp xếp của bạn.

paragraphs.label: Phương án khác
paragraphs.text: Could we meet at a cafe the following weekend instead? You could tell me what you learned when you tried to compare working schedules and plan shared team hours. I would be particularly interested in the idea that employees can organise work around practical personal needs. If there are notes or a short recording from the session, I would be happy to read or watch them first.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đề nghị thời điểm khác và giữ kết nối với chủ đề.

paragraphs.label: Kết thư
paragraphs.text:
I am sorry to miss this opportunity, but I hope you have a great time. Please let me know whether the new plan suits you.

Best wishes,
Minh
paragraphs.noteVi: Xin lỗi, chúc vui và xin phản hồi.
